notes: The reference is reviewer-independent: values come only from the ministry pages, never from artifacts shared with the rulespec-dk implementation.
Third-party sites circulate round-12 projections for 2026 (17.004 / 13.380); the ministry table is round-24 per LOV nr 1642 af 16/12/2025 and this extract records the ministry values.
2027 aftrapningsgraense is printed as 'Fastlaegges senere' and is intentionally absent.
